product_metadata.title: Creative QT Stuff ’n Sit Extra Large 38’’ Bean Bag Storage Cover for Stuffed Animals & Toys – Light Gray Corduroy – Toddler & Kids’ Rooms Organizer – Giant Beanbag Great Plush Toy Hammock Alternative
features: SOFT STORAGE SEATING: Our kids’ bean bag chair cover can be filled with stuffed animals, soft toys, blankets, pillows, towels, and more. Declutter the bedroom or use for playroom storage, keep stuffies tidy, and add a comfy-cozy new lounge chair-style seating option where kids can read, relax, and play. Choose from trendy colors, dinosaur, dandelion and unicorn prints, stripes, dots, and corduroys great for homes and classrooms. Inspiring, playful and practical décor choices

PREMIUM MATERIALS, LARGE CAPACITY: Our bean bag covers are made of high quality, upholstery-grade 100% cotton. Double-stitched seams, rugged handles, and double-sided heavy-duty zippers ensure this bean bag’s durability. Our large size measures 33’’, and our extra-large size measures 38’’ in diameter and holds about 90 plush toys or the equivalent in blankets, linens, or other soft extras. No stuffing included

EASY CARE, NO FUSS: Concerned about durability for spills and stains? Our children’s bean bag chair cover is 100% cotton and easy to clean. Simply machine wash on a gentle cycle and hang to dry. And our bean bag stuffed animal and toy storage solution is a great alternative to toy storage hammocks or toy boxes because it doesn’t require hooks or ties to secure – and it’s much more comfy

DECLUTTER (FOR FUN!): This stylish toy organizer bag helps you take control of stuffed animal collections and other stuffed toys, while encouraging kids to clean up their rooms at the same time. Tidying up is fun when the result is a comfy-cozy bean bag chair that looks great in any room – and ensures children can keep their ever-growing collection of stuffies safe and nearby

CHOOSE THE ORIGINAL: The Stuff ‘n Sit is the original, first-to-market stuffed animal bean bag chair cover with thousands of Amazon 5-star ratings to prove it! Designed by parents with a commitment to quality, safety, and kid-approved toys and storage solutions, by choosing Creative QT, you can be sure you’re getting products that have been rigorously tested to stand (and stuff and sit and store) above the competition
